# Turn a Patreon earnings export into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free Patreon payout to journal converter: proves the pledges add up to your payout, splits membership income, shipping, tax you collected, Patreon platform and processing fees and refunds by month, and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
